text: Average order value went up by 9000 BRL between 2016-12 and 2017-01. The largest contribution came from SP (5400 BRL). The second largest contribution came from RJ (3600 BRL). Average order value is defined as: Revenue divided by delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
